title: 3 Things Smart Money Does Before CPI (That You're Missing)
description: CPI drops this week and most traders are going to get wrecked. Here are 3 things smart money does before high-impact news — and how to use ICT concepts to stay on the right side. Follow R2F Trading for daily setups at r2ftrading.com
script: CPI drops this week. Most traders will blow up. Smart money already knows what's coming. Number one. They hunt liquidity BEFORE the news. Watch for a sweep of Friday's high or low this morning. That sweep? It's the trap. Retail traders chase the breakout. Smart money fades it. Every time. Number two. They mark the order block BEFORE price returns. Not after. If you're drawing it after — you're already late. Number three. They use the fair value gap as a magnet. CPI creates massive FVGs. Those gaps WILL get filled. The R2F Trading system uses all three of these — in that exact order — before every high-impact news event. Three accounts blown before learning this. Now? Consistent.
